bettersearch.config.title: Better Search
bettersearch.config.tagline: Smarter search bars for the Creative menu, the recipe book and command suggestions. Hover any option to read what it does and see a picture of it in action. Everything is saved when you close this screen.
bettersearch.config.reset_option: Restore this option to its default
bettersearch.config.enabled.desc: The master switch. Turn it off and every search bar goes back to being exactly the one Minecraft ships with.
bettersearch.config.enabled.tip: Off means the original search everywhere. Nothing is uninstalled and no setting is lost.
bettersearch.config.sort_by_relevance.de: Puts the closest match at the top instead of keeping the Creative tab order.
bettersearch.config.sort_by_relevance.ti: Off keeps the game's own order, the same one you see with an empty search bar.
bettersearch.config.max_results.desc: Keeps a very broad search from flooding the entire menu.
bettersearch.config.max_results.tip: Unlimited shows every match. Lowering it only trims the end of the list, never the best results.
bettersearch.config.typo_tolerance.desc: Lets a misspelled word still find the item.
bettersearch.config.typo_tolerance.tip: Higher forgives more slips per word. Long words get a little more room than short ones.
bettersearch.config.min_typo_length.desc: Short words have to be spelled right. This is what keeps a tiny search from matching half the game.
bettersearch.config.min_typo_length.tip: Words shorter than this are taken literally. Left forgives short words, right is stricter.
bettersearch.config.match_initials.desc: Finds an item from the first letter of each word in its name.
bettersearch.config.match_initials.tip: It has to start on the first word; small linking words in the middle may be skipped.
bettersearch.config.ignore_spaces.desc: Finds names typed all in one piece, with no spaces.
bettersearch.config.ignore_spaces.tip: Spaces become optional, never required. Typing them normally still works.
bettersearch.config.search_tooltips.desc: Also reads what an item does, so potions, tipped arrows and enchanted books can be found by their effect.
bettersearch.config.search_tooltips.tip: Only the lines shown under the item name. Costs a little memory while the index is built.
bettersearch.config.search_ids.desc: Lets you search by the item's internal name instead of its translated one.
bettersearch.config.search_ids.tip: Both forms work, with or without the mod namespace in front.
bettersearch.config.search_mods.desc: Type @ followed by a mod's name to see only that mod's items.
bettersearch.config.search_mods.tip: The filter can be combined with a normal search in the same line.
bettersearch.config.fuzzy_threshold.desc: Fixing your spelling is a second look the mod takes at your search. This decides how eager it is to take it.
bettersearch.config.fuzzy_threshold.tip: Balanced steps in when a search comes up short. Always is heavier and can bring in loose matches.
bettersearch.config.cross_field_threshol: Mixing languages inside one search is the widest net the mod can cast, so it normally waits until nothing else worked.
Raise it if mixed searches rarely work for you. Lower it if long searches start bringing in unrelated items.
bettersearch.config.cross_language.desc: Finds an item by its name in another language.
bettersearch.config.cross_language.tip: Only the languages enabled in the list below are searched. Your game language always is.
bettersearch.config.foreign_strict.desc: Names in other languages have to be spelled correctly to match.
bettersearch.config.foreign_strict.tip: Recommended. With many languages on, forgiving foreign spelling makes almost anything match.
bettersearch.config.cross_field.desc: Lets a single search borrow words from two languages at once.
bettersearch.config.cross_field.tip: Handy when you only remember half of a name. Uses the languages you enabled.
bettersearch.config.enabled_languages.de: Opens the language list, where every language the game knows has its own switch.
bettersearch.config.enabled_languages.ti: More languages find more items and use a little more memory.
bettersearch.config.languages.title: Search Languages
bettersearch.config.languages.summary: %s of %s languages enabled. Your game language (%s) is always searched, whether it is enabled here or not.
bettersearch.config.languages.entry: Language code: %s. Item names in this language will also be matched.
bettersearch.config.languages.entry.curr: Language code: %s. This is your current game language, so its item names are always searched.
bettersearch.config.search_creative.desc: Improves the search bar of the Creative inventory. This is the mod's main job.
bettersearch.config.search_creative.tip: Turning this off leaves the other search bars untouched.
bettersearch.config.search_recipe_book.d: Improves the recipe book search, so a recipe can be found by the name of what it makes.
bettersearch.config.search_recipe_book.t: Works everywhere the recipe book appears, in any language you enabled.
bettersearch.config.fix_commands.desc: Suggests the closest valid option when a word in a command comes out wrong.
bettersearch.config.fix_commands.tip: Covers command names, sub-options, gamerules and values inside selectors. While a fix is on offer the red text turns gold; press Tab to take it.
bettersearch.config.version_names.desc: Type the name from whichever version you remember and it goes through anyway.
bettersearch.config.version_names.tip: Works both ways: an old name on a new version, a new name on an old one. Covers /gamemode 1, the gamerules renamed in 1.21.11 and item and entity names that changed. Only a whole name gets swapped, so a typo still just gets a suggestion.
Suggests player names in chat and commands even when you get them slightly wrong.
Also covers /invite, /group, /grupo and /party, where the server never tells the game that the argument is a player. The game's own suggestions always come first.
bettersearch.config.search_command_items: Turns an item's name into its ID while you type a command, in any language you enabled.
Adds entries the game would not offer on its own. Its own suggestions still come first.
bettersearch.config.search_jei.desc: Applies Better Search inside JEI's item list.
bettersearch.config.search_jei.tip: JEI's item list starts using this exact search: the same languages, the same typo tolerance and the same ordering you picked here. Its own prefixes (#tag, $color, ^id, %tab) still belong to JEI.
bettersearch.config.search_rei.desc: Apply Better Search inside REI's item list.
bettersearch.config.search_rei.tip: REI's list starts using this exact search, with the languages, typo tolerance and ordering you picked here. Its own prefixes (#tooltip, $tag, *id, -exclude) still belong to REI.
bettersearch.config.search_emi.desc: Applies Better Search inside EMI's item list.
bettersearch.config.search_emi.tip: Same as JEI: EMI's list starts using this search, with the options on this screen. Its own prefixes (#tooltip, $tag, /regex) still belong to EMI.
bettersearch.config.command_suggestion_l: How many extra entries the mod may add to a suggestion list.
The game's own suggestions are never removed to make room for these.
